name: ImageCaptcha
syntax: ImageCaptcha( string text, numeric height, numeric width, [string difficulty], [any fonts], [numeric fontsize], [string fontcolor] )

params.name: difficulty
params.description:
Level of complexity of the CAPTCHA text.

Specify one of the following levels of text distortion: low, medium, high

params.name: fonts
params.description:
One or more valid fonts to use for the CAPTCHA text, as an array or as string list (separate multiple fonts with commas).
Lucee supports only the system fonts that the JDK can recognize. For example, TTF fonts in the Windows directory are supported on Windows.

params.name: fontsize
params.description: font size of the text in the CAPTCHA image.

params.name: fontcolor
params.description: font color of the text in the CAPTCHA image.
